resources.string: Choose what holding OK does on movie, episode and series cards. A short press keeps its usual action. The Menu button still opens actions. Other cards, settings and playback controls keep their existing behavior. Saved separately for each user and server on this TV.
Show the existing actions for the selected card.
Open the selected title’s details without starting playback.
Use the existing Play action. Movies and episodes start or resume; series show playback choices. Unavailable playback falls back to the actions menu.
Ignore holding OK on these title cards. Release does not also open the title.
